county_relationship.note: Counties come from each facility's resolved county. A ZIP can span several counties; the HUD USPS crosswalk (with weights) is not yet configured. Census ZCTAs approximate, but are not, USPS ZIP codes.

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.
Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.
Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
